Segment assurance US, principale source de véhicules total loss et coeur historique de Copart.

Expansion internationale (UK, Allemagne, Canada), moteur de croissance le plus dynamique.

kpis.name_fr: Croissance du prix de vente moyen (monde)

kpis.short: Purple Wave gross transaction value growth (LTM)
kpis.name_fr: Croissance de la valeur transactionnelle Purple Wave
kpis.signal: Valeur transactionnelle de la plateforme equipement lourd Purple Wave en hausse de plus de 25% sur 12 mois, portee par l'expansion territoriale
Frequence de perte totale a un record de 23,6% au 1er trimestre calendaire 2026, en hausse de pres de 5 points sur 4 ans, coeur du moteur de croissance long terme
Environ 1 000 ingenieurs a temps plein en Amerique du Nord, Europe et Asie, socle technologique le plus important de l'industrie
Pres de 16 000 acres de terrain dans le monde, dont environ 90% en pleine propriete, barriere a l'entree structurelle
Plus de 30 000 acheteurs entres via les vehicules hors assurance sur 3 ans, dont une forte majorite enchérit sur un vehicule assurance dans les 90 jours
Reprise spectaculaire des rachats: 24,3 M d actions rachetees pour ~898 M$ (37,11 $/action) entre le 31 janvier et le 2 mars 2026, apres des annees sans rachat.
5,48 M d actions rachetees pour 218,2 M$ (39,82 $/action) sur le premier semestre FY2026, premiere activation du programme depuis longtemps.

risks.title: Dependence on limited number of major vehicle sellers
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in risk factors (Item 1A). Strong language used (substantial portion, material adverse effect). Recurring risk with direct impact on revenues and financial position. No single customer exceeds 10% but limited sellers collectively represent substantial portion of revenues.
risks.summary: The company depends heavily on a small number of major vehicle sellers. Loss of one or more major sellers could materially harm financial results and growth rates. Inability to increase vehicle supply sources could adversely affect growth.

risks.title: Risks related to international expansion and acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Detailed across multiple sections (Item 1A). Strong language (substantial risks and uncertainties, adverse effect). International expansion is key strategy but complex with integration and profitability risks.
risks.summary: International expansion and acquisitions carry significant risks including integration failures, unforeseen costs, and inability to realize expected synergies, which could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and payment fraud risks
risks.score_rationale: Described in detail in dedicated section (Item 1A). Strong language (compromise or breach, significant legal and financial exposure). Online transaction security is critical to trust and operations.
risks.summary: Company faces exposure to online transaction security risks and credit card fraud. Data breach or fraud could result in significant financial losses and reputational harm.

risks.title: Inability to maintain storage facility capacity
risks.score_rationale: Explained in specific section (Item 1A). Language indicates potential impact (adversely affect relationships, material adverse effect). Storage capacity essential for seller relationships.
risks.summary: Insufficient storage facility capacity, particularly after climate events, can harm seller relationships and impact operations. Recent hurricane response (Hurricanes Helene and Milton in fall 2024) required significant mobilization.

risks.title: Failure to implement online auction model in new markets
risks.score_rationale: Presented as specific technology-related risk (Item 1A). Cautious language (cannot predict whether synergies will be realized). Inability to replicate past success is material concern.
risks.summary: Success of online auction model is not guaranteed in new markets. Inability to replicate U.S. and U.K. synergies in new geographies could limit growth potential.

risks.title: International operations and regulatory compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in international expansion section (Item 1A). Multiple risk areas mentioned (complex foreign and U.S. laws, tariffs, trade barriers). Operations span 11 countries with varying regulations.
risks.summary: Operating internationally exposes company to complex regulations, trade barriers, and geopolitical risks that could negatively impact operations and profitability.

risks.title: Dependence on transportation subcontractors
risks.score_rationale: Described in dedicated section (Item 1A). Language indicates potential impact (could harm reputation and brand, material adverse effect). Logistics is key operational component.
risks.summary: Reliance on third-party transportation contractors creates risks of delays, cost increases (fuel prices), and reputational damage if logistics issues occur.

company_description: Copart, Inc. provides online auctions and vehicle remarketing services in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Brazil, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, Spain, Finland, Oman, the Republic of Ireland, and Bahrain. It offers a range of services to process and sell vehicles over the internet through its virtual bidding third generation internet auction-style sales technology. The company's services include online seller access, salvage estimation, estimating, end-of-life vehicle processing, transportation, vehicle inspection stations, on-demand reporting, title processing and express, loan payoff, flexible vehicle processing programs, buy it now, sales process, and dealer services. Its services also comprise services to sell vehicles through BluCar, CashForCars.com, CashForCars.ca, CashForCars.de, CashForCars.co.uk, and Cash-for-cars.ie; Copart Recycling service, which allows the public to purchase parts from salvaged and end-of-life vehicles; and copart 360, a proprietary technology that captures clear 360-degree views of interiors and exteriors of cars, trucks, and vans.
